name: Agently
description: Agently Brain gives any MCP client a company brain: a temporal knowledge graph continuously built from everything a company connects to Agently — uploads, Slack, Gmail, HubSpot, Linear, GitHub, and 25+ other sources. Unlike per-session memory servers, the brain is shared across every agent and tool a team points at it, and its facts carry temporal validity, so agents can distinguish current truth from history. Six tools: search (hybrid semantic + keyword, results carry entity UUIDs), find_entity, get_neighbors (graph walking), get_schema, recent_episodes, and remember (write-scoped). Auth: workspace API keys or OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration. Every credential is pinned to one workspace server-side.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Agently to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Agently to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.agently.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Agently MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agently provides these MCP tools: find_entity, get_neighbors, get_schema, recent_episodes, remember, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Agently?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Agently in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Agently requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Agently is developed by Agently. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
